title: Figures 9-10: ePTFE lip implant before/after photos and biodegradable PLA mesh
description: Two pairs of close-up "BEFORE" and "AFTER" photos of lips, captioned "Figure 9. Expanded PTFE (Gore-Tex or ePTFE) Used in Lip Implants." Below, a photo of a clear twisted lattice-like polymer structure on a blue background is captioned "Figure 10. Biodegradable Polymers. Polymers such as PLA are much like conventional plastics...". The page covers ePTFE cosmetic implants and the 'Biodegradable Polymers' section.
